title: Renting in the UK: Homes, Rights and Scams
subtitle: Where to live, how renting works, and settling in without scams in the United Kingdom
description:
The complete guide to renting a home in the United Kingdom, written for newcomers and updated for the Renters' Rights Act 2025.

See the honest 2026 rental market, know the law on your side, and work out what renting really costs. Then search, view, apply, pass referencing with no UK history, prove your right to rent, arrange a guarantor and read your agreement before you sign. Learn how rental scams work and how to beat them, what a landlord may never do, how to choose a city and a type of home, and how rules differ in Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. Finally move in safely, set up bills and council tax, get repairs done, handle rent rises, leave properly and win your deposit back, with letter templates and a directory of free help.

Every figure carries the date it was checked, unconfirmed facts are marked, and the book is illustrated with real photographs.

General information, not legal or financial advice.
